    "When sentiment is strongly positive (1.00), model-forecasted lows are too high by ~0.5-1.0",

    "Sentiment mean-reversion: when 1.00 persists 4+ days, prices will begin declining",

    "When price history shows clear downtrend, model forecasts are too optimistic by 0.3-0.7"
